landing.title: Move money forward, with banks at the center.
landing.newDescription: Submit an institution inquiry to begin the eligibility review. Submitting an inquiry does not create a portal account.
landing.benefitsTitle: One Hazel experience from interest to production.

benefits.title: Bank-first onboarding
benefits.description: Eligibility, due diligence, account setup, technical readiness, and launch are presented as one coherent journey.

benefits.title: Clear responsibilities
benefits.description: Each step identifies what your institution needs to do and what Hazel is reviewing.

benefits.title: Designed for control
benefits.description: Role-based tasks, document requests, approvals, and go-live controls keep progress visible.

submitInterest.title: Join the Hazel Network
submitInterest.description: Tell us about yourself and your financial institution, and we'll make sure you qualify for joining the Hazel network.
submitInterest.requiredNote: Required fields are marked with an asterisk.
submitInterest.submissionError: We couldn't submit your inquiry right now. Please try again.
submitInterest.completeDescription: A Hazel team member will reach out soon with more information on next steps.
submitInterest.unsupportedTitle: Online verification is currently available for banks only.
submitInterest.unsupportedDescription: Hazel does not yet have an integrated registry lookup for this institution type. Online inquiries can currently be submitted for FDIC-verified banks.
submitInterest.devDescription: This control is available only in the local development build.

legalName.label: Legal institution name
legalName.hint: Use the institution’s complete legal name.

contactName.label: Contact name
contactName.hint: Enter the person Hazel should contact about this inquiry.

contactEmail.label: Business email
contactEmail.hint: Hazel will send the inquiry response to this address.

validation.fdic: Enter the FDIC certificate number using digits only.
validation.contactTitleRequired: Enter the contact’s role or title.
validation.email: Enter a valid business email address.
validation.verifyFdic: Verify the institution matching this FDIC certificate number.

lookup.label: Find your financial institution
lookup.hint: Enter the FDIC certificate number, then verify it with Hazel.
lookup.notFound: We could not find an institution matching that FDIC certificate number.
